content:
# Got the colophon page updated with the latest details. I hadn't touched it for a while and it was sorely out of date. It's still called /specs.

I've deliberately kept the Hello page as /EHLO (Extended Hello - an SMTP command used by servers to request extended features). It's geeky but also cycles back to my old blog from 2003. The tech posts on that site focused on Microsoft Server products, especially SharePoint (which I used to host it, yes SharePoint) and Exchange, so EHLO is a fitting echo.
